title: The Formation Wright's Canon
summary: A canon for wrights past the courses that lays small stone formations in the ground and holds them with sealed frames.

title: A Treatise on Keystone and Array
summary: A treatise on waking a whole array from one keystone and pressing foes down with the weight of the array.

title: The Twin Court Array Discipline
summary: A discipline of arrays laid in pairs so that each half guards the other and the foe is caught between them.

title: The Hawk and Azure Lattice Canon
summary: A canon of paired lattices that strike from above and cleanse those within them and bind the foe on both sides.

title: The Plateau Bearing Array Discipline
summary: A discipline of open arrays that take their bearing from the wind and never close around the maker.

title: The Wind-Sworn Array Canon
summary: A canon of arrays sworn to the wind that press and seal a foe by the maker's oath and heading.
